item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing that any major social institution became independently self-sustaining after Tshisekedi. The strongest positive evidence is mostly executive-sponsored reform, not autonomous institutional depth. I also did not find a national evaluation proving these reforms survived beyond the president’s personal sponsorship.","evidence":[{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation: une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government framed P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and cohesion program meant to restore state authority where absent. That is the clearest positive sign of trying to build a standing institution for demobilization and stabilization rather than relying only on personal crisis management.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.6"]},{"title":"Nomination d’une nouvelle équipe de coordination nationale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-relevement-communautaire-nomination-dune-nouvelle-equipe-de-coordination-nationale/","summary":"The presidency appointed a new national coordination team for P-DDRCS late in 2024. This suggests continued institutionalization rather than a one-off initiative, though it still does not prove long-term autonomy from the presidency.","question_ids":["6B.9"]},{"title":"Le chef de l'Etat a assisté à la cérémonie de rentrée judiciaire de la Cour des comptes","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_assiste_a_la_ceremonie_de_rentree_judiciaire_de_la_cours_des_comptes","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly backed the Court of Accounts’ accountability function, and the court said his support helped revive anti-corruption oversight and public-finance control. That is real institutional support, though still executive-centered.","question_ids":["6B.9"]},{"title":"Le chef de l'Etat a reçu le rapport annuel 2022-2023 de la Cour des comptes","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-25","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_recu_le_rapport_annuel_2022_2023_de_la_cour_des_comptes","summary":"The Court of Accounts publicly pressed for stronger legal tools to inspect public spending while Tshisekedi’s office received its annual report. This is evidence of active oversight machinery, but also that the institution was still seeking stronger leverage.","question_ids":["6B.9"]},{"title":"DRC: IMF reaches agreement on ECF and RSF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/13/pr-24416-drc-imf-reaches-agreement-on-ecf-and-rsf","summary":"The IMF package explicitly called for stronger treasury procedures, spending-chain controls, and decentralizing spending authorization to line ministries. That is one of the strongest signs of durable administrative institution-building I found, though still under close central control.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"Deux nouveaux programmes avec le FMI","publisher":"Ministère du Budget","date":"2024-11-15","url":"https://budget.gouv.cd/deux-nouveaux-programmes-avec-le-fmi-aime-boji-et-doudou-fwamba-etaient-devant-la-presse/","summary":"The budget ministry said the finance and budget ministers jointly presented the IMF programs and credited improved coordination since June 2024. That suggests the fiscal machine was being made more regular and professional, not just personalized.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"PR24253 DRC IMF executive board concludes 2024 Article IV consultation","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the authorities cleaned up the civil-service register using biometric identification, reorganized civil-service social security coverage, and launched a retirement program. That is direct evidence of institutional correction, though only in part of the state.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"DR Congo: Expanding and Equipping Primary School Classrooms for Better Learning Outcomes","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/02/28/democratic-republic-of-congo-afe-expanding-and-equipping-primary-school-classrooms-for-better-learning-outcomes","summary":"The education project emphasized stronger information systems, decentralized planning, and merit-based teacher recruitment. This is the clearest social-institution design evidence I found, because it goes beyond spending to the machinery of delivery.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.8","6B.5"]},{"title":"DR Congo president appoints country's first female prime minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"Tshisekedi appointed Judith Suminwa, a technocratic planning minister, as prime minister. That is supportive of some institutional professionalism, but it is still an appointment signal rather than proof of durable institutions.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.8"]},{"title":"Biographie de la Première Ministre","publisher":"Primature","date":"2024","url":"https://www.primature.gouv.cd/biographie-de-la-premiere-ministre/","summary":"Suminwa’s biography stresses applied economics, banking, UN/PNUD work, budget-ministry experience, and development-planning leadership. This supports a competence-based institutional staffing story, but not yet institutional autonomy.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.8"]},{"title":"DR Congo: President Tshisekedi must use second term to tackle human rights crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty said there had been little to no progress on prior pledges, that public resources were being squandered, and that shrinking civic space and socioeconomic injustice persisted. That is strong counterevidence against durable social institutions.","question_ids":["6B.9"]},{"title":"DRC President Felix Tshisekedi must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty said the state of siege militarized daily life, concentrated power in military and police hands, and subordinated civilian welfare. That points to coercive personalization, not resilient social institutions.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"Human Rights Agenda for the Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/06/human-rights-agenda-democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW said the government had made little progress on systemic reforms and needed stronger institutions and anti-corruption safeguards. This is explicit negative evidence that durable institutions were not yet being built.","question_ids":["6B.9"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW reported continued repression against journalists, activists, critics, and opposition members. A state that keeps punishing independent civic actors is not building institutions that can outlast a leader.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Congo election commission overspent, awarded opaque contracts report","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-15","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-election-commission-overspent-awarded-opaque-contracts-report-2024-01-15/","summary":"A civil-society report said CENI could not account for about $400 million and used opaque procurement. That is direct evidence of weak institutional integrity in a key public body, and it undermines any strong durability claim.","question_ids":["6B.9","6B.5"]}]}
